chars.J: JALAL: a slim young man wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie, black jogging trousers and white sneakers.
chars.M: MONTASSER: a chubby young man wearing a red-and-white horizontally striped t-shirt, blue jeans and a black cap worn backwards.
chars.C: THE RENTERS: a couple, the man in a white polo shirt with sunglasses pushed up on his head, the woman in a pink headscarf and a denim jacket, each pulling a big suitcase.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: At the open front door of a luxurious white Moroccan seaside villa with a turquoise swimming pool visible behind, JALAL nervously hands a key to the renter couple with a guilty sly grin, glancing over his shoulder as if afraid to be caught; the couple look excited. Afternoon sun.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Inside the elegant villa living room with fancy sofas, a big TV and a framed photo of a smiling blonde foreign woman on the wall, the renter man hands JALAL a thick stack of banknotes; JALAL grins happily while hiding the cash in his hoodie pocket.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: On a sunny Moroccan café terrace with mint tea glasses, JALAL talks on his phone smiling broadly while MONTASSER beside him gives an enthusiastic double thumbs-up, both delighted.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Same café terrace, JALAL holds the phone to his ear with a worried frown, staring at the screen; MONTASSER leans in anxiously, mouth open.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: JALAL and MONTASSER sit on a low wall of a seaside corniche at orange sunset, JALAL checking his phone again and again, MONTASSER biting his nails, both very tense, calm sea behind.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: At dusk in a quiet street, JALAL and MONTASSER walk fast side by side, JALAL looking scared and sweating, MONTASSER pale, gripping his cap.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: In the evening, JALAL and MONTASSER stand in front of the closed gate of the white seaside villa near Casablanca, the windows completely dark, the two friends look at each other with dread.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Close medium shot at the villa's front door at night: JALAL turns a key in the lock with a trembling mitten hand, eyes wide with fear, MONTASSER right behind him peeking over his shoulder holding his breath; the door is still closed, we do not see inside.
